 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    # A solid non-background line is the repeat separator; period is the distance between
    # separators (or distance from edge to the first separator).
    for axis,n,m in ((0,h,w),(1,w,h)):
        lines=[]
        for i in range(n):
            vals=[g[i][j] for j in range(m)] if axis==0 else [g[j][i] for j in range(m)]
            if len(set(vals))==1 and vals[0]!=bg: lines.append(i)
        if not lines: continue
        sep=lines[0]
        if len(lines)>1: period=lines[1]-sep
        else: period=sep+1
        if period<=0: continue
        # For each non-separator position, extend its corresponding motif within the grid.
        for i in range(n):
            if i in lines: continue
            src=i%period
            for j in range(m):
                get=lambda a,b: g[a][b] if axis==0 else g[b][a]
                put=lambda a,b,v: g.__setitem__(a, g[a][:b]+[v]+g[a][b+1:]) if axis==0 else g.__setitem__(b, g[b][:a]+[v]+g[b][a+1:])
                if axis==0:
                    v=get(src,j)
                else:
                    v=get(src,j)
                if v!=bg:
                    put(i,j,v)
        break
    return g
"
}
